closure.evidence: All27independent CLI probes passed. Exact initial recipe FIFO reproduction now refuses while a complete request is buffered and the writer stays open. No-writer recipe/glob/alias-base/source/registry/glyph FIFO cases refuse before deadline. Directory, oversized, symlink-to-FIFO, shared-consumer and source-hash refusals leave stdout empty.

limitations: Focused checks are not the full test suite; root race results are separate and not claimed here.

No protected original/shipping/custom-art ISO, canonical registry, owner emulator/probe/process, account settings or auth data was accessed.

shared_owner_review.initial_native_tag_correction: The initial review executed-tags native, which does not select the actual native font backend. This final review independently executes build/vet with the actual nativefonts tag.
shared_owner_review.no_function_growth: No new production named function was introduced for the closure.
readInput_callers: main.run initial recipes, alias bases, flow/observed registry, flow glyphmap and input identity rereads
shared_owner_review.refusals: Existing direct recipe-directory expansion remains; empty recipe directories retain their old dedicated error. Known special files reject beforeopen. Existing report pin/error semantics and source type checks remain separate from valid image source size.

what_this_change_does: The existing shared readInput now rejects known nonregular, empty or oversized paths before opening and checks opened-handle identity, size and modification time. Initial recipe and alias-base reads reuse that reader with a documented128MiB intake ceiling; report profiles keep their1MiB limit and image sources remain streamed.
